extras: The plugin is released under GPL-3.0 due to its dependency on LibreDWG.
intentEvidence: Preview .dxf and .dwg CAD drawings directly inside your Obsidian notes — no external CAD software, no leaving the app.
problem: Users must leave Obsidian and open external CAD software to view or inspect DXF and DWG drawing files.
summary: A lightweight desktop plugin that embeds a WebGL viewer to preview DXF and DWG CAD drawings directly within Obsidian notes.
